회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (High-tech), 초연결사회 (Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
직무 소개
브랜드 스페셜리스트는 쿠팡 벤더 서비스 (CSVS – Coupang Vendor Services) 팀의 일원으로 로켓배송에 입점한 주요 브랜드들을 대상으로 비즈니스 성장을 위한 다양한 전략 서비스를 제공하게 됩니다. 브랜드 스페셜리스트는 브랜드사의 성장 파트너로서 상품 운영 지원, 성과 데이터 분석, 매출 증대를 위한 실행 가능한 인사이트 제공 및 전략 수립을 하게 됩니다. 브랜드사의 핵심 성과 지표 달성을 위해 원활한 소통, 벤더 매니지먼트, 그리고 쿠팡 내부 팀과의 협업이 필수적이며, 이를 통해 브랜드사와 좋은 비즈니스 관계를 구축하고 그들의 서비스 만족도를 향상시킬 것입니다.

브랜드사의 상품 온보딩을 지원하고, 카탈로그 품질 개선 및 재고 관리 등 운영 업무
판매성과를 높이기 위한 프로모션, 노출 전략 등 제안 및 실행

We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

Join the FP&A team supporting The Hartford’s Global Specialty business, a dynamic and growing portfolio spanning specialty insurance products and markets around the world. In this role, you will help forecast financial performance, analyze business trends, and provide insights that influence strategic decisions across the organization.

Working at the intersection of finance, analytics, and technology, you'll collaborate with leaders across Finance, Accounting, Actuarial, Operations, and the business to understand performance drivers, evaluate opportunities, and support planning for the future. You'll gain hands-on experience with forecasting, financial modeling, automation, data analytics, and AI-enabled finance tools while building expertise in a complex and highly analytical industry.

Our ideal Senior Financial Analyst is intellectually curious, eager to learn, driven to continuously improve, and energized by partnering with others to solve problems and make an impact.

This role will have a Hybrid work arrangement, with the expectation of working in the office (Hartford, CT) 3 days a week (Tuesday through Thursday).

Drive Financial Insights That Influence Decisions

• Build and maintain forecasts for key P&C insurance financial metrics including premium, commissions, and other operating expenses
• Analyze actual results against forecast, budget, and prior year performance, identifying key drivers, emerging trends, risks, and opportunities.
• Partner with business leaders to translate financial results into clear insights and recommendations that support strategic decision-making.

Leverage Data, Analytics, and Technology

• Develop financial models and analytical tools that improve forecasting accuracy and business understanding.
• Use modern technologies such as Python, AI-enabled tools, Power BI, Power Query, and automation solutions to improve decision-making and reduce manual work

Gain Exposure to Business Strategy and Leadership

• Collaborate closely with Accounting, Actuarial, Operations, and business teams to understand what drives performance across the organization.
• Participate in strategic projects that shape how Finance supports business growth and decision-making.

Build a Foundation in Insurance Finance

• Learn how accounting, operations, actuarial assumptions, and business strategy connect to financial outcomes.

Qualifications

• Is intellectually curious and eager to learn new technologies, industries, and analytical approaches.
• Has strong communication skills and can tell a story with data.
• Thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment with exposure to senior leaders.

Technical Skills

• Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
• Experience with or strong interest in data analytics, automation, and AI-enabled tools.
• Exposure to Python, SQL, Power BI, Power Query, Alteryx, Tableau, or similar technologies a plus.
• Familiarity with enterprise planning and reporting tools such as TM1, Anaplan, Hyperion, or similar platforms a plus.

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. We are looking for an experienced HR Compliance Manager to establish and lead our EMEA People Compliance function. As a key member of the People Experience team, this role works in close partnership with AMER HR Compliance, Employment Legal, Privacy and People teams.

This is a highly collaborative and influential role requiring strong EMEA employment compliance expertise alongside experience in policy governance, regulatory change, risk and controls, data governance, and program management. The right candidate will have a strong interest in employment policies and legislative trends, extensive program management and vendor management experience, and desire to understand and improve processes. This role will also focus on process improvement opportunities and demonstrating industry best practices.

Based in London and reporting to the Senior Director, People Experience EMEA, this person will lead the EMEA HR Compliance & UK Leave of Absence teams. Join this highly collaborative HR team whose mission is to create a highly engaged work culture.

What you’ll be doing:

1. EMEA People Compliance Framework & Governance

• Build and lead the EMEA People Compliance framework, establishing governance, controls, ownership and reporting across the region

• Monitor relevant employment and regulatory developments across EMEA with the Legal team and translate requirements into practical People policies, processes and controls

• Develop reporting and metrics that provide visibility of compliance status, emerging risks and remediation.

2. Policy Governance & Regulatory Change

• Establish and manage the EMEA policy governance framework

• Partner with Employment Legal to translate legislative and regulatory change into scalable policies, processes and guidance

• Lead change management and capability-building associated with regulatory change, including training and guidance for PX teams

• Create clear governance across policies, handbooks, employee-facing articles and internal guidance

• Develop training and guidance so PX teams can confidently interpret and apply policies

• Act as an escalation point for complex scenarios and guide relevant teams

3. Employment Compliance Programs

• Oversee EMEA Right to Work and immigration compliance controls, including appropriate verification and reverification processes.

• Own the EMEA background screening process and vendor relationship for the region

• Partner with Talent Acquisition (TA), IT, and tech teams to enhance integrations between systems for best-in-class employee experience

• Establish and own the EMEA governance framework for fixed-term employment, partnering with TA, HRBP, Finance and PX to establish appropriate controls across hiring, extensions, renewals and termination

• Statutory/regulatory People reporting

• Compliance requirements arising from employee moves/international mobility

• Act as subject matter expert and first point of contact for EMEA employment policy questions, providing clear and accurate interpretation of policies in close partnership with Employee Relations (ER) and Employment Legal.

4. People Data Privacy & Record Retention Governance

• Lead EMEA personnel file governance, including the transition from local storage to Workday, and establish appropriate standards for retention, access, naming conventions and audit controls across Workday, SharePoint and other People platforms.

• Conduct periodic audits, identify control gaps, and oversee remediation.

• Establish scalable governance for employee DSARs and other data rights requests, define best practice and clear roles and responsibilities

5. Audit, Risk & Assurance

• Develop and lead regional People compliance risk assessments, translating identified risks into appropriate controls, assurance activity and remediation plans

• Own/coordinate HR controls supporting internal and external audits, including SOX

• Provide People Compliance expertise for M&A due diligence, integration planning and acquisition onboarding.

6. Capability, Technology & Continuous Improvement

• Build compliance capability across PX through training, guidance and practical tools

• Identify opportunities to automate controls and reduce manual compliance activity

• Partner with PTS/People Technology on system controls and enhancements

• Build meaningful compliance dashboards and reporting

• Manage relevant third-party providers and budgets

• Drive continuous improvement and simplification

• Establish effective governance for employee-facing compliance and policy content across People platforms, ensuring information is accurate, current, accessible and appropriately maintained.

7. UK & Ireland Leave of Absence Leadership

• Lead the UK & Ireland Leave of Absence function, ensuring effective controls, reporting and employee/manager support, in partnership with ER, Benefits, Payroll and PX

• Provide oversight and guidance on complex or exceptional LOA cases, ensuring consistent and equitable application of policy.

Core Partners: Employment Legal, Privacy, Employee Relations, People Technology, AMER HR Compliance, Talent Acquisition, Benefits and Global Mobility.

Wider Stakeholders: Corporate Legal, Security, IT, Information Security, Health & Safety, Facilities, Studio HR, Sony Group companies, Finance and external vendors.

jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will own the full commercial relationship and customer’s success across a book of 50 to 100 mid-market accounts - the builders, founders, and product teams at companies between 250 and 2,000 employees who are defining what AI-native experiences look, feel, and sound like. Your job is to make sure every one of them is getting real value, expanding into new products, and renewing with conviction.

This is a high-agency, high-impact role. You won't succeed by managing accounts one at a time - you'll build the systems, playbooks, and motions that let you drive meaningful outcomes across a diverse book while going deep with the accounts that have the most room to grow. If you love the challenge of being a true partner to your customers without losing commercial sharpness, this role was built for you.

On the ground, you'll be in the product with customers - advising on agent design, voice customization, conversation flows, integrations, and using data and logs to spot friction before customers do. You're the person who connects what's working technically to what's growing commercially and partnering closely with high growth accounts to help them achieve value.

Success of the customer and commercial ownership go hand in hand and are at the core of this role. You own NRR across your managed book of business, you drive cross-sell into ElevenLabs' expanding product suite, and you lead renewals end to end. The best AMs at ElevenLabs don't just retain customers, they grow with them.

COMPENSATION

This role offers a competitive on target earnings (OTE) structure with a split of 70% base and 30% variable. Variable compensation is weighted 70% net revenue retention (NRR) and 30% product cross sell. Cross-sell performance counts toward NRR, so strong expansion compounds across both components. Quota is set on managed ARR, giving you clear ownership over a defined book of business. The plan includes accelerators for above target NRR performance and is designed to reward account managers who grow with their customers, not just retain them. Variable compensation is paid on a quarterly basis.

REQUIREMENTS

- 3 to 5 years of Account Management or Customer Success experience in B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products - you know what great looks like and you've delivered it in a complex, fast-moving environment

- A proven track record of owning revenue outcomes end to end - quota, renewals, and expansion - without defaulting to a handoff to a sales team

- You approach your book with commercial intent: you segment by expansion potential, keep active expansion conversations going, and build business cases that land with economic buyers

- You can hold a technical conversation with a developer or engineering team and earn their trust - familiarity with AI concepts, API integrations, and SDKs is a must

- You use product data to stay ahead of your accounts - spotting health signals, identifying expansion opportunities, and getting in front of risk before it becomes churn

- You know how to read a room - whether you're with a founder, a technical lead, or a procurement team, you show up with the right message and leave with the relationship stronger

Preferred

- Experience in the voice AI, audio AI, or conversational AI space

- Experience selling or expanding into multiple products within a platform

LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in ET, CT, MT, or PT timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York City or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our offices in these cities.

• 5+ years of experience on a live service game, shipping a variety of different features and content types to react to changing player patterns
• Strong scripting and technical capabilities. Bonus points if you have experience with Unreal Engine and the Ability System
• Demonstrated talent and a deep understanding of gameplay feel, player motivations or intent, gameplay mechanics, systemic content, and the core LEGO player fantasy
• Ability to break down high-level creative direction into actionable gameplay features and production-ready tasks

Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? Security at DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt runs on telemetry, and our data pipelines team owns all of it. About the Team

The DeployCo Deal Desk helps turn customer deployment opportunities into clear, executable professional-services engagements. We partner across Deployment, Sales, Legal, Finance, Technical Revenue, and Operations to ensure every deal has a well-defined scope, pricing aligned to approved guardrails, complete approvals, and a clean handoff to delivery.

About the Role

We are hiring a hands-on Professional Services Commercial Lead to own the end-to-end deal desk workflow for assigned DeployCo professional-services engagements. You will personally draft and revise statements of work (SOWs), validate pricing and deal inputs, coordinate cross-functional reviews and approvals, and ensure commitments are clear, deliverable, and ready to execute.

The differentiator in this role is drafting expertise: you have written SOWs, not simply routed them. You can turn technical and delivery inputs into precise scope, deliverables, milestones, assumptions, dependencies, acceptance criteria, fees, and change controls—then keep the deal moving.

- 3+ years of substantial, hands-on experience drafting and revising customer-facing SOWs for professional-services engagements.

- Experience operating pricing-validation, commercial intake, approval, and routing workflows alongside contract drafting and review.

- Sound judgment and independent ownership of complex or non-standard deals, including the ability to recommend a practical path forward and escalate the highest-risk issues.

- Working knowledge of quote-to-cash and how SOW structure and pricing affect delivery, billing, revenue recognition, and the customer experience.

- Clear, concise communication; excellent attention to detail; and the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive deals while influencing partners without formal authority.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience as a contract manager supporting customer-facing professional services, consulting, implementation, or managed services.

- Experience in cloud, enterprise SaaS, AI, or another complex technology environment.

- Familiarity with fixed-fee, milestone-based, and time-and-materials services engagements.
